Transfer.G Transfer.A = Transfer.S Transfer.A ∧
  Transfer.S Transfer.B = Transfer.F Transfer.B ∧

∀ (c x : ℝ),
  IEANTN.CMSFunctional.halfOpenCount c x =
    IEANTN.CMSFunctional.piReal (x + c * √x * Real.log x) - IEANTN.CMSFunctional.piReal x

∀ {c x : ℝ},
  0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ Transfer.upper c x → ∀ (p : ℕ), p ∈ Transfer.halfSet c x ↔ Nat.Prime p ∧ x < ↑p ∧ ↑p ≤ Transfer.upper c x
∀ (c x : ℝ), Transfer.upper c x = x + c * √x * Real.log x
∀ {c x : ℝ}, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ Transfer.upper c x → IEANTN.CMSFunctional.halfOpenCount c x ≤ (Transfer.openSet c x).card + 1

∀ {c x : ℝ}, x ≤ Transfer.upper c x → (Transfer.halfSet c x).card = IEANTN.CMSFunctional.halfOpenCount c x
∀ (c x : ℝ), Transfer.openSet c x = {p ∈ Transfer.halfSet c x | ↑p < Transfer.upper c x}
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s t : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ s \ t) = (a ∈ s ∧ a ∉ t)
